Bundled lossless AVIF encoder
============================

The avifenc binaries are unmodified upstream x86-64 release artifacts of
AOMediaCodec/libavif 1.4.2:
https://github.com/AOMediaCodec/libavif/releases/tag/v1.4.2

Archive SHA-256 values were verified against the digests published by the
GitHub release API. The archive URLs, digests, extracted executable digests,
and license source URLs are recorded in manifest.json.

The upstream release build statically includes these dependencies:
  libaom 3.14.1         LICENSE-aom.txt, PATENTS-aom.txt
  dav1d 1.5.3          LICENSE-dav1d.txt
  libyuv 644251f25     LICENSE-libyuv.txt
  libsharpyuv 1.6.0    LICENSE-libsharpyuv.txt, PATENTS-libsharpyuv.txt
  libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1 LICENSE-libjpeg-turbo.md, LICENSE-IJG.txt
  libpng 1.6.58        LICENSE-libpng.txt
  zlib 1.3.2           LICENSE-zlib.txt

The libavif license and its included third-party notices are reproduced in
LICENSE-libavif.txt. The source revision and release workflows are available
in the upstream repository. On Windows the binary also uses the Microsoft
C runtime already required by the bundled Python runtime.

This software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group.

The Windows application bundles windows/avifenc.exe and these notices.
linux/avifenc is provided for development and verification on x86-64 Linux.

No executable is downloaded while the application runs.
